fields.acceptance: In this repo, rhiza workflow describe ship-change resolves to the builtin; rhiza workflow describe ship-rhiza shows the [env], the go-cleanup cleanup running sh .rhiza/workflows/go-cleanup.sh and the builtin's 10 steps; rhiza workflow describe bugfix still shows the go-cleanup cleanup; rhiza workflow check passes with no new warning beyond the autonomous ones AGENTS.md expects; rhiza check accepts .rhiza/dispatch.toml naming ship-rhiza for [ready] feature and bugfix for bug; make self-check passes. Touches .rhiza/workflows/ship-change.toml (removed), .rhiza/workflows/ship-rhiza.toml, .rhiza/dispatch.toml, .rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml.
fields.statement: Rhiza's own repo runs the builtin conductor default: its .rhiza/workflows/ship-change.toml shadow is removed, its [env] (GOTMPDIR, SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA, SHIP_HEAD_BUILD) and its [[cleanup]] go-cleanup (sh .rhiza/workflows/go-cleanup.sh) move to a thin .rhiza/workflows/ship-rhiza.toml that includes the builtin ship-change, .rhiza/dispatch.toml sets [ready] feature = "ship-rhiza", and bugfix.toml keeps its own [env] and [[cleanup]] go-cleanup and includes the new builtin.
